entries.title: Psalms 93:1
segments: ¶The Lord is King; he is clothed with glory; the Lord is clothed with strength; power is the cord of his robe; the world is fixed, so that it may not be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 93:2
segments: The seat of your power has been from the past; you are eternal.

entries.title: Psalms 93:3
segments: The rivers send up, O Lord, the rivers send up their voices; they send them up with a loud cry.

entries.title: Psalms 93:4
segments: The Lord in heaven is stronger than the noise of great waters, yes, he is stronger than the great waves of the sea.

entries.title: Psalms 93:5
segments: Your witness is most certain; it is right for your house to be holy, O Lord, for ever.
